geopolitics_summary: US diesel export ban threat and Middle East conflict drive EU fuel crisis; Macron seeks energy truce and regulatory relief.

themes.headline: Trump threatens 90-day US diesel export ban; EU supplies >50% from US
themes.why_it_matters: US supplies >50% EU diesel. Ban triggers refinery margin compression, power plant fuel-switching to gas (TTF upside), and storage draw acceleration. Direct EU energy security shock.

themes.headline: France extends fuel subsidies amid soaring energy prices
themes.why_it_matters: Government fuel subsidy caps retail signals, suppressing demand-side price discovery. Indirect downward pressure on wholesale power if heating fuel demand falls; but may extend crisis duration and political pressure for broader rate caps.

themes.headline: Macron seeks energy truce between Ukraine and Russia; pushes regulatory relief
themes.why_it_matters: Negotiated gas ceasefire could unlock Russian supply, collapsing TTF and power spreads. Methane reporting delay removes compliance costs on operators, loosening policy floor on European gas incentives.

themes.headline: Germany cuts fuel tax; calls for oil company windfall tax amid conflict
themes.why_it_matters: Tax cuts ease consumer pressure but erode fiscal buffers; windfall tax on refiners compresses refining margins and output, risking power plant fuel availability and Cal+1 spread widening.

themes.headline: Corpus Christi LNG expansion completed; now US second-largest LNG facility
themes.why_it_matters: 7th train online increases US LNG export capacity ~1 bcf/d. Boosts US-NW Europe LNG arb competitiveness, raising TTF arbitrage competition and potential seasonal supply downside if US prioritizes Asian pricing.

watchlist: US diesel export ban announcement and 90-day implementation timeline.
Macron–von der Leyen energy policy alignment decision on methane reporting delay.
EU Commission windfall tax proposal on oil/gas refiners; member state adoption pace.
Ukraine–Russia ceasefire negotiations and any energy corridor agreement terms.
